baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain قَالَ / لَا تَسْمَعُوا / ٱلْغَوْا / تَغْلِبُونَ links speech, blocked hearing, injected noise, and hoped-for dominance.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken plural command couples refusal to hear with mixed raised sound in the recitation's channel. Occupying that channel is the means by which the speakers hope to overpower the recitation.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech launches the coordinated instruction.
Auditory perception is the channel the command tells the group to close.
Recitation supplies the target signal against which the counter-sound operates.
Mixed raised noise supplies the interference that masks the target signal.
Overpowering is the stated hoped-for result, making the interference tactical.

changed_reading.before: The disbelievers merely refuse to listen and make noise.
changed_reading.after: They issue a coordinated acoustic-jamming instruction in which channel occupation is a technique of domination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَفَرُوا, تَسْمَعُوا, قُرْءَان, and ٱلْغَوْا permit a second mechanism at the level of recognition and account, not volume alone.
baseline_models.mechanism: The gathered recitation is denied uptake by treating it as material to be thrown out of account. Blocking hearing as understanding and acceptance lets the group control not only what is audible but what is allowed to count.

activation_trace.role: Denial and obstruction of truth supply the governing posture toward the message.
Hearing as understanding, acceptance, and compliance is the uptake being blocked.
Gathering and coherence make the Qur'an an assembled body of meaning to be socially disaggregated.
What is cast out of account supplies the mechanism of semantic nullification.
Dominance is achieved by controlling what the audience recognizes as consequential.

changed_reading.before: Noise makes the recitation difficult to hear.
changed_reading.after: The campaign also tries to remove the recitation from communal account so that hearing never becomes acknowledgment or obedience.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural speakers combine circulating قول with the group-tongue branch of لغو and a collective hope of prevailing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The counter-speech may be sustained social saturation rather than a single interruption. Widely circulated talk and a group tongue obsessed with its own speech can crowd the recitation out by making the rival discourse ambient.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people supplies a social carrier for the instruction.
The recited discourse is the rival voice the ambient talk seeks to crowd out.
Fixation on speech and a group's habitual tongue turn momentary noise into a repeated social idiom.
The hoped-for victory gives that social saturation its competitive purpose.

changed_reading.before: The scene is a momentary heckle during recitation.
changed_reading.after: It can also be a campaign to build a rival communal tongue whose constant circulation makes revelation socially inaudible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening presents the Qur'an as differentiated into intelligible parts and explicitly expressed. The focus noise is therefore anti-articulation: mixed sound collapses the perceptual distinctions by which a detailed utterance becomes understandable.

activation_trace.role: Detail that discloses parts and meanings supplies the articulation the noise works to blur.
Explicit expression supplies the intelligibility targeted by deliberate acoustic mixing.
Understanding and acceptance identify the threatened result of clear articulation.
The recitation carries the differentiated utterance into the contested auditory field.
Mixed noise functions as an anti-detailing medium that erases audible boundaries.

structural_cues: 41:3 names a detailed Arabic Qur'an before the sequence of non-hearing and the focus command.
The focus repeats Qur'an as the object, so the contrast is between articulated recitation and mixed counter-sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differentiation, explicitness, and mixed noise; I supply the arrow that mixing sound destroys perceptual separation. A live alternative is simple heckling without an informational mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The opponents try to be louder than the recitation.
changed_reading.after: They try to undo its audible differentiation, replacing articulated meaning with an undivided sound field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier non-hearing is described through coverings, ear-weight, and a barrier. The focus command turns those claimed conditions into a collective practice: mixed noise externally manufactures the deafness and separation the speakers had described as already present.

activation_trace.role: The earlier failure to understand or accept establishes the condition later made imperative.
Protective covering supplies the inner enclosure that public noise externalizes.
Literal heaviness in the ear supplies the aural blockage the group now helps produce.
Prevention of access supplies the relational barrier created between reciter and audience.
Covering anchors the focus action as deliberate concealment rather than passive incapacity.
Mixed raised noise is the external material from which the barrier is made.

structural_cues: 41:4 states that most do not hear, 41:5 supplies the anatomy of blockage, and 41:26 converts non-hearing into a plural command.
The move from self-description to coordinated imperative makes the barrier operational.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated cover, weight, barrier, and noise images; I infer that the focus socially manufactures an earlier claimed incapacity. The alternative is that 41:5 remains only a rhetorical description and 41:26 a separate tactic.

changed_reading.before: The audience happens to be unreceptive and later adds noise.
changed_reading.after: The audience collectively engineers unreceptivity, building an external acoustic version of its claimed covered hearts and burdened ears.

context_deltas.mechanism: The auditory faculty the focus tries to suppress later speaks as an informed witness, while attempted covering is explicitly denied. Read retrospectively, 'do not listen' becomes failed evidence control: the sense may be denied uptake, but it cannot be prevented from registering and testifying.

activation_trace.role: Testimony stated from knowledge turns sensory registration into adverse evidence.
The hearing faculty itself becomes the witness the earlier command cannot silence.
Covering and concealment are explicitly linked to the failed attempt to escape sensory testimony.
Covering in the focus anchors the later witness scene as a reversal of concealment.
The command targets the same auditory channel that later bears witness.

structural_cues: 41:20 makes hearing a witness and 41:22 places concealment directly beside that testimony.
The focus joins covering with a command against hearing, allowing the later scene to reverse both terms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies suppressed hearing, failed concealment, and later testimony; I infer a retrospective evidence-control mechanism. The materially live alternative is that testimony is only a consequence and was never part of the speakers' conscious aim.

changed_reading.before: The command aims only to prevent persuasion in the present.
changed_reading.after: It also reads as a doomed attempt to suppress the sensory record that will later testify against its makers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Paired companions beautify the surrounding worldview, and the misled later identify agents who led them astray. That social ecology sharpens the plural focus command into a peer-amplification network: circulating group speech makes rejection mutually plausible and mutually enforceable.

activation_trace.role: A companion joined to a companion supplies the peer links through which the tactic propagates.
Making something appear good supplies the reinforcement that renders the group's rejection attractive.
Circulating speech carries the instruction across the paired social network.
A group's habitual tongue supplies the repeated discourse that maintains collective resistance.
The hoped-for domination gives the network a shared competitive objective.
Being led away from the intended path reveals the directive agency later blamed within the network.

structural_cues: 41:25 immediately precedes the focus with companions who beautify what surrounds their partners.
41:26 uses plural speakers, plural imperatives, and a plural victory, while 41:29 later seeks the agents of misdirection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship, beautification, plural coordination, and later blame; I infer a peer-amplification network connecting them. A live alternative is that the companions describe a broader moral ecology rather than the immediate noise-makers.

changed_reading.before: A hostile crowd independently shouts over a reciter.
changed_reading.after: Linked peers circulate and reward a shared counter-discourse, making acoustic disruption one practice of a larger social reinforcement system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hoped-for غلبة is spatially reversed when the same disbelieving collective asks to put its misleaders beneath its feet and among the lowest. The coalition formed to dominate the recitation implodes into an internal hierarchy of trampling and degradation.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering establishes the upward dominance the speakers hope to secure.
Misdirection identifies the former allies who become targets of the reversed dominance.
Position beneath supplies the first downward reversal of the hoped-for victory.
The foot that treads supplies the concrete image of former coalition members subjugating one another.
Descent to the lowest place completes the inversion of anticipated ascendancy.

structural_cues: The focus ends with a plural hope of prevailing; 41:29 returns to the same disbelieving speakers and renders their social hierarchy vertically.
Beneath, feet, and lowest form a concentrated downward sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hoped-for overpowering and a later downward placement of misleaders; I infer a designed reversal of the dominance axis. The alternative is that 41:29 is a punishment image not specifically keyed to 41:26.

changed_reading.before: The coalition expects to dominate the Qur'an and its reciter.
changed_reading.after: Its desired hierarchy reverses inward: the alliance of domination ends with its members seeking to trample and lower their own guides.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence supplies a counter-program to 'say, make noise, prevail': best speech calls rather than jams, good action accompanies it, and repelling with what is better converts an enemy into a close ally. The focus becomes the failed coercive mirror of a non-silencing social victory.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the hostile program that the later speech sequence reverses.
False or ugly speech supplies the negative speech-quality answered by what is better.
Coercive overpowering supplies the focus's model of success.
Goodness opposed to ugliness supplies the explicit evaluative reversal of the focus speech.
Uttered speech reappears as the medium of the constructive counter-program.
Calling and drawing by speech replace the focus's attempt to repel by interference.
Removing what is harmful supplies a response to hostility that does not reproduce its noise.
Love, support, and alliance supply the transformed relation produced by the better response.
Near kin-like intimacy gives the transformed enemy relation its strongest social form.

structural_cues: 41:33-34 concentrates speech, calling, better action, enmity, and transformed alliance in one sequence.
Both the focus and the later sequence address how speech acts within conflict, but they produce opposite social outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two speech programs and an explicit enemy-to-ally transformation; I infer that this transformation is the surah's alternative form of victory. The live alternative is that 41:33-34 gives ethical response without intentionally answering تَغْلِبُونَ.

changed_reading.before: The verse records one effective way hostile speech seeks victory.
changed_reading.after: It exposes a counterfeit victory by silencing, later answered by better speech whose success is the conversion of enmity into intimate alliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The attempt to make لغو 'in it' sounds like an invasion of the recitation, but the later book is difficult to reach and falsehood cannot arrive at it. The repeated ear-weight and distant call relocate the effect: noise does not enter and corrupt the Qur'an; it burdens and displaces the hearer.

activation_trace.role: The recited Qur'an is the apparent object the interference tries to invade.
False and ugly speech supplies the attempted contaminant.
Understanding and acceptance locate the actual vulnerable interface in the hearer.
Difficulty of access supplies the book's resistance to the attempted intrusion.
Invalidation and removal name the operation that is explicitly unable to reach the book.
Ear-weight places the obstruction in the receiver rather than in the recitation.
The range and remoteness of a raised call turn failed reception into acoustic distance.
Distance from proximity completes the hearer's displacement from an otherwise intact message.

structural_cues: 41:41-42 shifts from people rejecting the reminder to the book's inaccessibility to falsehood.
41:44 repeats Qur'an, articulation, Arabic, ear-weight, and non-reception before locating the addressees at a distant place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted false speech, an unbreached book, burdened ears, and a distant call; I infer that the damage is transferred from text to receiver. A live alternative is that فِيهِ simply means making noise during the recitation and never implied textual corruption.

changed_reading.before: Counter-speech enters the Qur'an's performance and overpowers or contaminates it.
changed_reading.after: The Qur'an remains unbreached; the counter-speech instead makes its practitioners heavy-eared and acoustically remote from what is still calling them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the second غلب branch is a material image of thickness and interweaving rather than ordinary victory. It remains anchored in تَغْلِبُونَ beside mixed noise and gives a coherent masking mechanism, but downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, not a lexical replacement for prevailing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacency of mixed noisy لغو and the thickening/interweaving branch of غلب permits a sound-mesh image.

activation_trace.role: Abundant speech supplies repeated strands for the proposed sound mesh.
Mixed raised noise supplies the acoustic material being layered.
Thickening and interweaving supply the material geometry by which repeated noise masks the recitation.

changed_reading.before: Noise wins by being momentarily louder.
changed_reading.after: Noise may be imagined as repeated strands thickened around the recitation until they form a masking acoustic mesh.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-scene reading is surprising because it compares a human propaganda order with the cosmic speech sequence rather than claiming a direct lexical gloss. It remains anchored in the focus's قول, blocked receptive سمع, and noisy response, but should be rendered as a whole-surah inversion: one command elicits willing answer while the other organizes non-reception.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's spoken command against receptive hearing can be set against 41:11-12, where command is received, answered, and obeyed.

activation_trace.role: Uttered command and uttered answer supply a completed speech-response circuit.
Willing compliance supplies the reception outcome inverted by the focus command.
Divinely conveyed information extends the model from hearing a command to receiving ordered communication.
Binding request supplies the ordered content received within each heaven.
The human speakers likewise issue an uttered command, anchoring the inversion.
Understanding and compliance are precisely what the human command tells its audience to prevent.
Mixed noise replaces the willing answer with an engineered anti-response.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains an ordinary hostile instruction.
changed_reading.after: It can be carried as an inverted ordering speech-act: instead of communication producing reception and willing response, command is used to organize non-reception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a scale analogy, surprising because horizons, selves, witness, and encompassing knowledge are not acoustic glosses. It remains anchored in the focus's local attempt to overwhelm a recited sign, but downstream prose should qualify the claim: the whole-surah field outscales the tactic rather than the roots directly redefining لغو or غلب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The local hope that mixed noise can prevail is outscaled by signs distributed across horizons and selves and by encompassing witness.

activation_trace.role: Mixed local sound supplies the bounded interference whose scale is tested.
The hope of overpowering supplies the scale claim that the later field reverses.
Visible signs supply evidence that is not confined to one recitation event.
Far horizons distribute the evidentiary field beyond the local acoustic venue.
The self as the very identity of the thing places evidence inside the would-be noise-maker as well.
Witness grounded in knowledge closes the evidentiary field around the local denial.
Complete encompassing in knowledge prevents local interference from defining the total field.

changed_reading.before: Controlling one auditory scene could plausibly defeat the message.
changed_reading.after: The tactic is radically local: the surah distributes signs across outer and inner fields that noise cannot enclose or outscale.

strongest_changes: The focus became a manufactured-deafness operation that externalizes the coverings, ear-weight, and barrier of 41:4-5.
Later sensory testimony recast suppression as failed control of an auditory witness.
Companion reinforcement and the downward imagery of 41:29 turned collective victory into a social network that finally inverts against itself.
The best-speech sequence supplied a rival model of success: transform enmity rather than silence an opponent.
The protected-book and distant-call sequence relocated the tactic's damage from the Qur'an to the burdened, displaced hearer.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah reconstruction exposed a repeated chain of acoustic, social, evidentiary, and spatial reversals around the focus's compact progression from speech to blocked hearing, noise, and hoped-for dominance.
remaining_uncertainties: فِيهِ may mean making noise during or against the recitation without implying an attempted intrusion into the text.
The witness-control reading is retrospective and need not describe the speakers' conscious motive.
The companion network may name a broader moral ecology rather than the immediate noise-makers.
The thick sound mesh, inverted cosmic command, and distributed-sign scale model remain explicitly analogical.
